summary.text: Karen M. Peterson is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 13 (Clearfield, Clinton, Sunset and West Point), selected in a December 2021 special election and in office since January 2022. She works as Community Development Manager for Sunrise Engineering.

paragraphs.text: Peterson previously worked as Legislative Policy Director for Gov. Spencer Cox and as Deputy Education Policy Advisor for Gov. Gary Herbert.

She is a two-term member of the Clinton City Council, earned a bachelor's degree from Utah State University and a Master of Public Administration from Southern Utah University, where she has worked as adjunct faculty.
She lives in Clinton with her husband, Eric, and their three children.
